description:
## Mandatory context and boundaries
Read the parent epic first. Applicable owners: AGENTS.md; docs/agent-tools.md; docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md; docs/action-reuse.md; docs/testing-approach.md; docs/services/channels.md (communication/Jido bridge and provider contracts); docs/services/engine.md (history, admission, finalization and delivery). Read docs/documentation.md before documentation/skill edits, docs/services/system-config.md before credential fixtures, and local module @moduledoc before extending a helper. Apply code-quality for code and skill-creator for the skill.
Only test/ additions or backward-compatible support changes, lib/mix/tasks/zaq.test.gen.channel.ex, and .agents/skills/add-channel-integration-tests/** are authorized. Do not edit application modules, dependency source/pins, config, migrations, mix.exs, CI, or unrelated skills. Existing-test expectation changes require the testing handbook's explicit approval; this epic authorizes additive coverage, not changing expectations.
Use real bridges, NodeRouter, Engine admission/history/persistence and configured Agent execution. Only provider/LLM boundaries are faked. A production defect is a reported blocker with a reproducer; do not patch production, silently omit a scenario, weaken an assertion, or close the issue as complete.
Validation timing, failure handling and final gates are owned by docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md. Record executed commands/results in this issue. No new browser E2E is needed: this work adds test/developer infrastructure without changing a deployed UI journey. No commit/push/merge authorization is implied.

Parent epic: zaq-o9d

## Functional specification and files
Create .agents/skills/add-channel-integration-tests/SKILL.md in this checkout. This exact repository skill location is user-required. Do not use test/skills, ~/.codex/skills, another worktree or Zaq.Agent.Skills. Optional agents/openai.yaml is allowed only if produced/needed by the skill-creator workflow.
Read and apply the available skill-creator instructions. Keep the skill concise and task-specific; YAML name is add-channel-integration-tests. Description should trigger when adding/completing provider integration-test drivers using the generator, not generic production adapter development or all channel changes.
The skill must require this sequence:
1. Read current test README, Driver/Registry contract and applicable repository policy owners; inspect the existing production adapter/module/capabilities and nearby test fakes. No need to reload the whole policy map.
2. Confirm the production adapter is available and the integration is absent; run generator --dry-run, inspect expected test-only paths, then run the generator using the exact required --adapter.
3. Implement every generated callback with native provider payloads and a local HTTP/fake transport boundary. Reuse real adapters or thin test delegators and existing LLM mocks; wire actual saved connectors and channel-enabled agents through IntegrationCase.
4. Complete provider-specific tests and prove required direct/shared/history/failure semantics. Derive optional capability declarations from source; missing required support is a reported blocker.
5. Run conformance/targeted scenarios for the new provider, then the FULL registered-provider matrix and affected pre-existing regressions, followed by the repository validation lifecycle.
6. Report native ingress boundary, fake boundary, tested/missing provider coverage, exact commands/results, and allowed-path diff audit. Completion cannot be claimed on only the new provider's green tests.
State explicit stopping conditions: missing production adapter; needed app/dependency/config changes; changed existing test behaviour without separate approval; real regression; unresolved capability semantics. Stop the affected change, report evidence, preserve the reproducer and request specific scope/contract clarification. Never skip a required scenario, unregister a driver or stub internal application modules to finish.
The skill does not authorize messages/PR publication/commits/push/merge, install tools/dependencies, or modify unrelated skills. It links to maintained test templates/contracts rather than copying their implementation.

## Tests/validation to add before implementation
- Validate frontmatter/naming/references and unfinished placeholders with skill-creator's validator after writing.
- Walk through a realistic 'add tests for an already installed adapter' scenario against an isolated generated fixture to check instructions map to actual task flags, paths and callback names.
- Check missing production adapter and pre-existing integration instructions prevent accidental overwrite/dependency work.
- Verify the instructions explicitly retain all-provider regression and test-only generated scope.
No new application tests or browser E2E are needed solely for prose. Avoid brittle tests that match exact skill wording. Behavioral rehearsal can be done without delegating; no subagent or external side effect is required by this task.

## Branches/paths validated
New integration, existing integration, missing production support, driver implementation failure, full-matrix failure and scope violations.

## Mocking plan
No new mock implementation is owned here. Rehearsal uses generator fixtures from the preceding issue and the real test-support contracts.

## Documentation
Skill entrypoint links to test/support/channels/integration/README.md via a correct repository-relative path, plus policy owners. Update README with the exact repository skill invocation/path. Do not edit AGENTS.md/docs/ or install a user-level copy.

## Action reuse assessment
Not applicable to new executable domain Actions: this is repository agent guidance invoking the existing developer Mix task and ExUnit suite. Reuse those tools/contract owners; no new runtime tool, workflow step or production skill.

## Done when
Skill is discoverable at the requested repository location, validates successfully, matches actual generator/harness behavior, and directs an agent to finish all-driver regressions without app/dependency changes.

comments.text: Created .agents/skills/add-channel-integration-tests/SKILL.md at the user-required repository path. Workflow covers installed-adapter prerequisite, existing-integration handling, generator preview/create, all callbacks/native provider boundaries, real saved connector/Agent/history, all-driver regressions and allowed-path audit. A real regression blocks affected acceptance while independent work continues. Rehearsal via isolated generator fixture proved exact flags/files/unfinished failure; missing adapter and overwrite tests pass. Skill-creator quick_validate.py reports Skill is valid (isolated uv/PyYAML environment; no repo dependency change). Local links checked and valid. README documents commands, file structure, script examples, transcript projection and three known Telegram blockers.
